name: Related Posts Display
author: Bhavesh Nayi

sections.description:
Related Posts Display automatically shows relevant posts under each blog post, encouraging visitors to explore more content on your site.

It intelligently fetches related posts based on shared tags and categories, helping increase page views and engagement. It works out of the box with sensible defaults, and the number of related posts shown can be adjusted from the Customizer.

Key Features:
* Automatically displays related posts based on tags and categories
* Choose how many related posts to display (1–12) via the Customizer
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* Works out of the box with sensible defaults — no configuration required to get started
* Compatible with most themes and latest WordPress versions
* Easily customizable via CSS and the Customizer

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/related-posts-display directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open any blog post to see related posts displayed below the content
sections.faq:
How are related posts determined?

Related posts are selected based on matching tags and categories of the current post.

Can I change the number of related posts displayed?

Yes. Go to Appearance → Customize and set “Number of Related Posts to Display” (1–12). It defaults to 3.

Does this plugin support custom post types?

Currently, it supports only standard posts. Support for custom post types may be added in future updates.

Does it affect site performance?

No, the plugin is optimized and uses caching to improve performance.
